title: SCAFDS: code and synthetic data for an explainable graph intelligence framework for interbank fraud surveillance
description: Code, synthetic interbank graph, simulated diagnostic-graph generator and per-seed results supporting the F1000Research article 'An Explainable Graph Intelligence Framework for Human-Centric Interbank Fraud Surveillance and Attribution-Grounded Regulatory Narrative Generation'. Data and results files are additionally released under CC BY 4.0.
